sar.narrative: On on 2016-12-01, card C07987-K2 belonging to customer C07987 was utilized in 1 unauthorized transaction(s) (3503878) totaling $99.92 USD. The flagged activity conforms to card not present new device methodology. Forensic analysis identified shared device infrastructure (DeviceProfile-HHG-019 | Android 7.0 | Chrome) linking this cardholder to coordinated activity. The cardholder was contacted via customer verification protocols and confirmed that they did not initiate or authorize these charges. Under bank fraud policy Policy R2/R6, the card has been blocked and flagged for law enforcement reporting due to confirmed illicit activity.
